title: Dynaboard: An Evaluation-As-A-Service Platform for Holistic Next-Generation Benchmarking
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a platform for holistic model evaluation. While 'fairness' is a key metric, which is an ethical consideration, the paper does not benchmark models on their understanding or application of religion, morals, or complex ethical frameworks. It measures demographic fairness through perturbations, not moral or ethical reasoning capabilities.
